prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer.
Asset: transparent medieval fantasy dialogue portrait.
Substantially REDRAW the man in image 1 as a tight head portrait. Image 1 is the identity reference only, not its full-body composition or large white eyes. Images 2–5 are only small-grid portrait style and mature anatomy references, never their identities.
Character: Tafei (塔斐), man in his forties, a weathered travelling companion and limited one-item collection agent. Preserve the recognizable broad cheeks, thick rounded projecting nose, warm peach/tan skin, slightly receding brown hair and distinctive light brown drooping split moustache, clean-shaven chin. IMPORTANT latest character-card update: gray hair at both temples and a modest worn gray-brown soft travel cap with a low slim brim, without covering his eyebrows or eyes. Keep his face clearly middle-aged, not sixty or elderly. Preserve the old faded blue travel-coat color as a narrow collar, a tiny cream inner neckline and small worn gray mantle edge. No badge or luxury.
Expression: troubled earnest explanation, the inner eyebrows raised only slightly and asymmetrically, outer brows relaxed, small mouth slightly open beneath the moustache, one corner taut, gaze toward the listener slightly to the viewer's left. Worry about a friendship being dismissed, not a servant's submissiveness, not rage, not a frightened child. Mature nasolabial fold and cheek planes; restrained forehead creases. The nose, broad face and moustache distinguish him from all other portraits.
Composition is critical: one close HEAD portrait, not a bust. Design for a 74 by 100 logical pixel canvas. Very large face: crown near y=3, chin near y=85, only a 4-pixel short supporting neck and a very narrow clothing edge in the bottom 7–9 pixels. Keep the complete hair/hat crown, all visible ears and side silhouette INSIDE the raw canvas, with at least 2 logical pixels clear transparent margin on both sides and above. Neck and collar fit inside bottom edge. Make the face broad enough to read at 1x. No shoulders, chest, arms, hands, props or scene.
Pixel style: the small reference portraits define the facial plane scale. Coarse intentional hard-edged low-resolution clusters, broad connected angular nose, cheekbones and forehead planes. At most 32 flat muted earthy colors total. Small dark realistic adult eyes, tiny muted tan-gray sclera, no large bright white sclera. Hair/facial hair only a few contiguous color masses; no fine strands, speckles, hatching, stippling or repeated stripes. Transparent background, crisp silhouette, restrained warm light.
Avoid: high-resolution painted skin, gradients, antialiasing, blur, glossy eyes, large cartoon eyes, anime, fine pixel noise, dithering, halos, text, labels, borders, watermark. Preserve identity and distinct expression. One portrait only.
